---------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m5p2t1 ----------------------------
(* Car-wash conveyor line. Cars occupy three conveyor slots (entry, wash,
   exit). Advancing a car from one slot to the next requires a quorum of the
   wash controllers to approve; approval messages may arrive in any order and
   may be retracted. A car leaving the exit slot recirculates to entry, so the
   total number of cars on the line never changes. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers
Slots == 0..2
Quorum == 2
Total == 3

VARIABLES load, approvals, retracted, cycles

vars == <<load, approvals, retracted, cycles>>

Approved(s) == Cardinality(approvals[s]) >= Quorum

TypeOK ==
    /\ load \in [Slots -> 0..Total]
    /\ approvals \in [Slots -> SUBSET Controllers]
    /\ retracted \in [Slots -> SUBSET Controllers]
    /\ cycles \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ load = [s \in Slots |-> IF s = 0 THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ approvals = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ retracted = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ cycles = 0

Vote(c, s) ==
    /\ load[s] > 0
    /\ c \notin approvals[s]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {c}]
    /\ retracted' = [retracted EXCEPT ![s] = @ \ {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cycles>>

Retract(c, s) ==
    /\ c \in approvals[s]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![s] = @ \ {c}]
    /\ retracted' = [retracted EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cycles>>

Advance(s) ==
    /\ s < 2
    /\ load[s] > 0
    /\ Approved(s)
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1, ![s+1] = @ + 1]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ retracted' = [retracted EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED cycles

Recirculate ==
    /\ load[2] > 0
    /\ Approved(2)
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![2] = @ - 1, ![0] = @ + 1]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![2] = {}]
    /\ retracted' = [retracted EXCEPT ![2] = {}]
    /\ cycles' = (cycles + 1) % (Total + 1)

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, s \in Slots : Vote(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, s \in Slots : Retract(c, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Advance(s)
    \/ Recirculate

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserved ==
    load[0] + load[1] + load[2] = Total
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2, c3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
nl: A car-wash conveyor line has three slots in sequence: entry, wash, and exit. A fixed fleet of cars is threaded onto the line. Moving a car forward from one slot to the next is not automatic: a set of wash controllers must vote to approve each advance, and the move only fires once a quorum of controllers has approved it. Approval messages travel over an unreliable bus, so they may arrive in any order, and a controller may retract its approval before the quorum is reached. When a controller votes, its approval for that slot is recorded and any prior retraction is cleared; when it retracts, its approval is withdrawn. Once a quorum approves an advance, the car moves to the next slot and the approvals for that slot are reset. A car that reaches the exit slot, once a quorum approves, recirculates back to the entry slot rather than leaving the line, and a cycle counter is bumped. Because every action either moves a car between slots or recirculates it, no car is ever created or destroyed. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of cars across the entry, wash, and exit slots always equals the fixed fleet size.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m8p6t1 ---------------------------
(* Library book reservation with hierarchical locks. To reserve a book a
   patron must first hold the coarse lock on the book's shelf, then the fine
   lock on the book itself. Reservation requests travel over a queue that may
   reorder them. A patron's borrowing privileges can be revoked; a revoked
   (stale) patron must not retain any book lock. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Patrons, None
Books == 1..3
Shelves == 1..2
ShelfOf(b) == IF b = 3 THEN 2 ELSE 1
Holder == Patrons \cup {None}

VARIABLES coarse, fine, revoked, requests, authority

vars == <<coarse, fine, revoked, requests, authority>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [Shelves -> Holder]
    /\ fine \in [Books -> Holder]
    /\ revoked \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ requests \in SUBSET (Patrons \X Books)
    /\ authority \in 0..3

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [s \in Shelves |-> None]
    /\ fine = [b \in Books |-> None]
    /\ revoked = {}
    /\ requests = {}
    /\ authority = 0

Request(p, b) ==
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ <<p, b>> \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {<<p, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, revoked, authority>>

AcquireShelf(p, s) ==
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ coarse[s] = None
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, revoked, requests, authority>>

Grant(p, b) ==
    /\ <<p, b>> \in requests
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ coarse[ShelfOf(b)] = p
    /\ fine[b] = None
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = p]
    /\ requests' = requests \ {<<p, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, revoked, authority>>

Revoke(p) ==
    /\ p \notin revoked
    /\ revoked' = revoked \cup {p}
    /\ coarse' = [s \in Shelves |-> IF coarse[s] = p THEN None ELSE coarse[s]]
    /\ fine' = [b \in Books |-> IF fine[b] = p THEN None ELSE fine[b]]
    /\ requests' = {r \in requests : r[1] # p}
    /\ authority' = (authority + 1) % 4

Reinstate(p) ==
    /\ p \in revoked
    /\ revoked' = revoked \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, requests, authority>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : Request(p, b)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, s \in Shelves : AcquireShelf(p, s)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : Grant(p, b)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Revoke(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Reinstate(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleHold ==
    \A b \in Books : fine[b] # None => fine[b] \notin revoked
===========================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {pa, pb}
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleHold
nl: A library runs a book reservation system with hierarchical locking. Books sit on shelves; before a patron can reserve a specific book, they must first take the coarse lock on that book's shelf, and only then may they take the fine lock on the book itself. Patrons submit reservation requests into a shared queue that does not preserve order, so requests may be granted in any sequence. A grant fires only if the requesting patron currently holds the shelf's coarse lock and the book's fine lock is free. The library can revoke a patron's borrowing privileges at any time; when a patron is revoked, they are marked stale, every shelf and book lock they hold is immediately released, all of their outstanding requests are dropped, and the authority epoch is advanced. A revoked patron may later be reinstated. Because revocation always strips a stale patron of every lock, no stale patron can continue to hold a reservation. SAFETY PROPERTY: no book's fine lock is ever held by a patron who has been revoked.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m4p4t5 ---------------------------
(* Smart-home door-lock network. Lock/unlock commands are buffered in a
   bounded work queue with backpressure: an incoming command is refused once
   the queue is full. A privileged admin can bypass the queue to toggle a door
   directly and can flush the buffer, but neither path ever lengthens the
   queue, so the buffer never exceeds its capacity. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Doors
Cap == 3

VARIABLES queue, locked, admin, processed

vars == <<queue, locked, admin, processed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Doors)
    /\ locked \in [Doors -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ admin \in BOOLEAN
    /\ processed \in 0..6

Init ==
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ locked = [d \in Doors |-> TRUE]
    /\ admin = FALSE
    /\ processed = 0

Enqueue(d) ==
    /\ Len(queue) < Cap
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, d)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<locked, admin, processed>>

Process ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ LET d == Head(queue) IN
       locked' = [locked EXCEPT ![d] = ~@]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ processed' = (processed + 1) % 7
    /\ UNCHANGED admin

EnterAdmin ==
    /\ ~admin
    /\ admin' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, locked, processed>>

AdminToggle(d) ==
    /\ admin
    /\ locked' = [locked EXCEPT ![d] = ~@]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, admin, processed>>

AdminFlush ==
    /\ admin
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ queue' = << >>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<locked, admin, processed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Doors : Enqueue(d)
    \/ Process
    \/ EnterAdmin
    \/ \E d \in Doors : AdminToggle(d)
    \/ AdminFlush

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityOK == Len(queue) <= Cap
===========================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Doors = {d1, d2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl: A smart-home network controls a set of door locks. Lock and unlock commands are not applied immediately; they are buffered in a bounded work queue that applies backpressure. When the queue is already full, an incoming command is refused rather than appended, so the buffer cannot grow past its fixed capacity. A worker processes the queue one command at a time, popping the oldest command and toggling the target door's lock state. A privileged administrator can enter admin mode; while in admin mode the administrator may toggle any door directly, bypassing the queue entirely, and may flush the entire buffer at once. Neither the direct toggle nor the flush ever appends to the queue, and ordinary enqueue is blocked whenever the queue is full. SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of buffered commands in the work queue never exceeds the queue's fixed capacity.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p2t1 ---------------------------
(* Library reservations with optimistic concurrency. A fixed number of book
   copies circulate among three buckets: available, reserved, and borrowed.
   A state transition is staged against a snapshot of the catalog revision and
   commits only if the revision has not moved; otherwise the client retries.
   Revision-sync messages may interleave arbitrarily. Copies only move between
   buckets, so their total is conserved. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

Buckets == 1..3
Total == 3
None == 0
Mod == 4

VARIABLES pool, revision, snap, pending, retries

vars == <<pool, revision, snap, pending, retries>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in [Buckets -> 0..Total]
    /\ revision \in 0..Mod-1
    /\ snap \in 0..Mod-1
    /\ pending \in {None, 1, 2, 3}
    /\ retries \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ pool = [b \in Buckets |-> IF b = 1 THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ revision = 0
    /\ snap = 0
    /\ pending = None
    /\ retries = 0

\* stage a move of kind k: 1 avail->reserved, 2 reserved->borrowed, 3 borrowed->avail
Begin(k) ==
    /\ pending = None
    /\ pending' = k
    /\ snap' = revision
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, revision, retries>>

Src(k) == IF k = 1 THEN 1 ELSE IF k = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 3
Dst(k) == IF k = 1 THEN 2 ELSE IF k = 2 THEN 3 ELSE 1

Commit ==
    /\ pending # None
    /\ snap = revision
    /\ pool[Src(pending)] > 0
    /\ pool' = [pool EXCEPT ![Src(pending)] = @ - 1, ![Dst(pending)] = @ + 1]
    /\ revision' = (revision + 1) % Mod
    /\ pending' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, retries>>

Retry ==
    /\ pending # None
    /\ snap # revision
    /\ pending' = None
    /\ retries' = (retries + 1) % (Total + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, revision, snap>>

Sync ==
    /\ revision' = (revision + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, snap, pending, retries>>

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in {1, 2, 3} : Begin(k)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Retry
    \/ Sync

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserved == pool[1] + pool[2] + pool[3] = Total
===========================================================================

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
nl: A library reservation service uses optimistic concurrency instead of locks. Every book copy is in exactly one of three buckets: available, reserved, or borrowed. A client that wants to move a copy between buckets first stages the intended transition and records a snapshot of the current catalog revision number. The transition commits only if, at commit time, the catalog revision still equals the snapshot the client took; if a revision-sync from another node bumped the revision in the meantime, the commit is refused and the client retries from scratch. Revision-sync messages arrive in arbitrary order relative to staged transitions. The three transitions are available-to-reserved, reserved-to-borrowed, and borrowed-to-available; each simply moves one copy from a source bucket to a destination bucket, and every commit bumps the revision. Because copies are only ever moved between buckets and never minted or discarded, the total copy count holds steady. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of book copies across the available, reserved, and borrowed buckets always equals the fixed collection size.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m6p5t1 ----------------------------
(* Elevator bank dispatcher with lease-based authority. A controller must hold
   an unexpired dispatch lease to commit a call to a car. Committing a call is
   irreversible; a lease can expire as the clock advances, and a stale
   controller's commit is refused. Dispatch messages sit in an unordered inbox
   and may be delivered or dropped in any order, but each floor call is
   committed to a car at most once. *)
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, None
Calls == 1..2
MaxT == 3

VARIABLES committed, owner, expiry, clock, inbox

vars == <<committed, owner, expiry, clock, inbox>>

Valid == owner # None /\ expiry > clock

TypeOK ==
    /\ committed \in [Calls -> 0..2]
    /\ owner \in Controllers \cup {None}
    /\ expiry \in 0..MaxT
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ inbox \in SUBSET (Controllers \X Calls)

Init ==
    /\ committed = [c \in Calls |-> 0]
    /\ owner = None
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ inbox = {}

GrantLease(ctl) ==
    /\ (owner = None \/ expiry <= clock)
    /\ owner' = ctl
    /\ expiry' = IF clock + 2 <= MaxT THEN clock + 2 ELSE MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, clock, inbox>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, owner, expiry, inbox>>

Send(ctl, cl) ==
    /\ <<ctl, cl>> \notin inbox
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {<<ctl, cl>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, owner, expiry, clock>>

Commit(ctl, cl) ==
    /\ <<ctl, cl>> \in inbox
    /\ owner = ctl
    /\ Valid
    /\ committed[cl] = 0
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![cl] = 1]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {<<ctl, cl>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock>>

Drop(ctl, cl) ==
    /\ <<ctl, cl>> \in inbox
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {<<ctl, cl>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, owner, expiry, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E ctl \in Controllers : GrantLease(ctl)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E ctl \in Controllers, cl \in Calls : Send(ctl, cl)
    \/ \E ctl \in Controllers, cl \in Calls : Commit(ctl, cl)
    \/ \E ctl \in Controllers, cl \in Calls : Drop(ctl, cl)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOnce == \A cl \in Calls : committed[cl] <= 1
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {ct1, ct2}
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOnce
nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper is coordinated by dispatch controllers. Authority to commit a floor call to a car is granted as a time-limited lease: a controller may take the lease only when no lease is held or the current one has expired, and the lease carries an expiry deadline measured against a shared clock. As the clock ticks forward, an outstanding lease can lapse. Controllers send dispatch messages into a shared inbox that imposes no ordering; a message may be delivered or dropped in any order. Committing a floor call to a car is an irreversible physical action. A commit fires only when the committing controller currently holds a valid, unexpired lease and the call has not already been committed; a controller whose lease has lapsed is treated as stale and its commit is refused. The full action set is: grant a lease, tick the clock, send a dispatch message, commit a call, and drop a message. SAFETY PROPERTY: each floor call is irreversibly committed to a car at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m4p3t1 ----------------------------
(* Power-grid load shedder. Shed requests pair a feeder slot with a load and
   sit in a bounded request pool with backpressure: no new request is admitted
   once the pool is full. A granter drains the pool in arbitrary order and
   allocates a slot to a load only when that slot is currently unallocated, so
   a feeder slot is never granted to two loads at once. Grants can be released,
   and pending requests can be dropped. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Loads
Slots == 1..2
Cap == 3

VARIABLES pending, grants, shed, served

vars == <<pending, grants, shed, served>>

GrantsFor(s) == { g \in grants : g[1] = s }

TypeOK ==
    /\ pending \in SUBSET (Slots \X Loads)
    /\ grants \in SUBSET (Slots \X Loads)
    /\ shed \in [Loads -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ served \in 0..6

Init ==
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ shed = [l \in Loads |-> FALSE]
    /\ served = 0

Request(s, l) ==
    /\ Cardinality(pending) < Cap
    /\ <<s, l>> \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<s, l>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, shed, served>>

Grant(s, l) ==
    /\ <<s, l>> \in pending
    /\ GrantsFor(s) = {}
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<s, l>>}
    /\ pending' = pending \ {<<s, l>>}
    /\ shed' = [shed EXCEPT ![l] = TRUE]
    /\ served' = (served + 1) % 7

Release(s, l) ==
    /\ <<s, l>> \in grants
    /\ grants' = grants \ {<<s, l>>}
    /\ shed' = [shed EXCEPT ![l] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, served>>

Drop(s, l) ==
    /\ <<s, l>> \in pending
    /\ pending' = pending \ {<<s, l>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, shed, served>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots, l \in Loads : Request(s, l)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, l \in Loads : Grant(s, l)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, l \in Loads : Release(s, l)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, l \in Loads : Drop(s, l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDouble == \A s \in Slots : Cardinality(GrantsFor(s)) <= 1
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Loads = {L1, L2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDouble
nl: A power-grid load shedder decides which loads to shed onto which feeder slots. Operators submit shed requests, each pairing a feeder slot with a load, into a bounded request pool. The pool applies backpressure: once it is full, further requests are refused rather than admitted. A granting process drains the pool in arbitrary order rather than strictly first-in-first-out. When it grants a request, it checks that the requested feeder slot has no existing allocation; only then does it allocate the slot to that load and mark the load as shed. A granted allocation can later be released, which frees the slot and clears the load's shed flag, and a request that is still pending can be dropped from the pool. Because a slot is only ever granted while it has no current allocation, no feeder slot is handed to two loads simultaneously. The full action set is: submit a request, grant a request, release a grant, and drop a pending request. SAFETY PROPERTY: no feeder slot is ever allocated to more than one load at the same time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m0p3t1 ----------------------------
(* Interbank settlement batch with optimistic concurrency. Each bank claims a
   settlement slot by staging the claim against a snapshot of the batch
   revision; the claim commits only if the revision is unchanged and the slot
   is still unclaimed, otherwise the bank retries. Commits and stages interleave
   in any order. A slot is never held by two banks at once. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks
Slots == 1..2
Mod == 4
NoSlot == 0

VARIABLES claimed, revision, pendSlot, pendSnap, retries

vars == <<claimed, revision, pendSlot, pendSnap, retries>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ claimed \in [Slots -> SUBSET Banks]
    /\ revision \in 0..Mod-1
    /\ pendSlot \in [Banks -> {NoSlot} \cup Slots]
    /\ pendSnap \in [Banks -> 0..Mod-1]
    /\ retries \in 0..3

Init ==
    /\ claimed = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ revision = 0
    /\ pendSlot = [b \in Banks |-> NoSlot]
    /\ pendSnap = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ retries = 0

Stage(b, s) ==
    /\ pendSlot[b] = NoSlot
    /\ pendSlot' = [pendSlot EXCEPT ![b] = s]
    /\ pendSnap' = [pendSnap EXCEPT ![b] = revision]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claimed, revision, retries>>

Commit(b) ==
    /\ pendSlot[b] # NoSlot
    /\ pendSnap[b] = revision
    /\ claimed[pendSlot[b]] = {}
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![pendSlot[b]] = {b}]
    /\ revision' = (revision + 1) % Mod
    /\ pendSlot' = [pendSlot EXCEPT ![b] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pendSnap, retries>>

Retry(b) ==
    /\ pendSlot[b] # NoSlot
    /\ pendSnap[b] # revision
    /\ pendSlot' = [pendSlot EXCEPT ![b] = NoSlot]
    /\ retries' = (retries + 1) % 4
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claimed, revision, pendSnap>>

Release(b, s) ==
    /\ b \in claimed[s]
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ revision' = (revision + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pendSlot, pendSnap, retries>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Slots : Stage(b, s)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Commit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Retry(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, s \in Slots : Release(b, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDouble == \A s \in Slots : Cardinality(claimed[s]) <= 1
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Banks = {B1, B2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDouble
nl: A bank runs an interbank settlement batch using optimistic concurrency rather than pessimistic locks. The batch has a small number of settlement slots, and each participating bank wants to claim a slot. To claim a slot, a bank first stages its intended claim, recording which slot it wants and a snapshot of the current batch revision number. The claim commits only if two conditions hold at commit time: the batch revision still matches the snapshot the bank took, and the target slot is still unclaimed. If another bank's commit has advanced the revision since the snapshot, the staging bank detects the conflict and retries from scratch. Every successful commit and every release advances the revision. A bank may also release a slot it holds, freeing it for others. Because a commit only ever writes a slot that is currently unclaimed, a settlement slot is never assigned to two banks at the same time. The full action set is: stage a claim, commit a claim, retry after a conflict, and release a held slot. SAFETY PROPERTY: no settlement slot is ever claimed by more than one bank simultaneously.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m5p6t0 ----------------------------
(* Container-ship crane yard. Each crane move is approved by a quorum of
   cranes and then carried out by an elected executor crane. A crane can crash
   silently at any time; a crashed crane is stale and may neither vote nor
   execute, and if the current executor crashes its execution rights are
   revoked immediately. Thus no crashed crane is ever the standing executor. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cranes, None
Slots == 1..2
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES crashed, votes, executor, moves, target

vars == <<crashed, votes, executor, moves, target>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ crashed \in SUBSET Cranes
    /\ votes \in SUBSET Cranes
    /\ executor \in Cranes \cup {None}
    /\ moves \in 0..4
    /\ target \in {None} \cup Slots

Init ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ executor = None
    /\ moves = 0
    /\ target = None

Propose(t) ==
    /\ target = None
    /\ executor = None
    /\ target' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, votes, executor, moves>>

Vote(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ target # None
    /\ executor = None
    /\ c \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, executor, moves, target>>

Elect(c) ==
    /\ executor = None
    /\ target # None
    /\ c \in votes
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(votes \ crashed) >= Quorum
    /\ executor' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, votes, moves, target>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ votes' = votes \ {c}
    /\ executor' = IF executor = c THEN None ELSE executor
    /\ UNCHANGED <<moves, target>>

Execute ==
    /\ executor # None
    /\ executor \notin crashed
    /\ moves' = (moves + 1) % 5
    /\ executor' = None
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ target' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, executor, moves, target>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Slots : Propose(t)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Vote(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Recover(c)
    \/ Execute

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleExecutor == executor # None => executor \notin crashed
============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {k1, k2, k3}
    None = NONE
INIT Init
NEXT Next

Orders == {"o1", "o2"}
NoSlot == 0
NoOrder == "none"

    /\ propSlot \in {NoSlot} \cup Slots

    /\ propOrder' = o

    /\ propSlot' = NoSlot

    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ propSlot' = NoSlot

    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, allocated>>

   locks. Each flight appears in the clearance log at most once. *)

Flights == 1..2
RunwayOf(f) == f

Logged(f) == \E i \in DOMAIN log : log[i] = f

    /\ runway \in [Runways -> Controllers \cup {None}]
    /\ log \in Seq(Flights)
    /\ crashed \in SUBSET Controllers

    /\ runway = [r \in Runways |-> None]
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ crashed = {}

    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ regionLock = None
    /\ regionLock' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<runway, log, crashed>>

AcquireRunway(c, r) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ regionLock = c
    /\ runway[r] = None
    /\ runway' = [runway EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, log, crashed>>

    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ regionLock = c
    /\ runway[RunwayOf(f)] = c
    /\ ~Logged(f)
    /\ log' = Append(log, f)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, runway, crashed>>

    /\ regionLock' = IF regionLock = c THEN None ELSE regionLock
    /\ runway' = [r \in Runways |-> IF runway[r] = c THEN None ELSE runway[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, crashed>>

    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ regionLock' = IF regionLock = c THEN None ELSE regionLock
    /\ runway' = [r \in Runways |-> IF runway[r] = c THEN None ELSE runway[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED log

    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, runway, log>>

    \/ \E c \in Controllers, r \in Runways : AcquireRunway(c, r)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Flights : Clear(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Recover(c)

   cold-storage pool of fixed capacity. Depositing a unit into a site requires

(* Stock-exchange opening auction under epoch-numbered reconfiguration. A
   participant may match an order only while its token epoch equals the current
   configuration epoch. A reconfiguration bumps the epoch, making participants
   stale until they refresh; refreshing to a new epoch drops the participant's
   prior-epoch matches. A participant can also crash, dropping its matches.
   Thus every live match is stamped with its matcher's current epoch. *)

Orders == 1..2
Mod == 3

vars == <<epoch, pEpoch, matchedBy, matchEpoch, crashed>>

    /\ epoch \in 0..Mod-1
    /\ pEpoch \in [Participants -> 0..Mod-1]
    /\ matchedBy \in [Orders -> Participants \cup {None}]
    /\ matchEpoch \in [Orders -> 0..Mod-1]
    /\ crashed \in SUBSET Participants

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ pEpoch = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ matchedBy = [o \in Orders |-> None]
    /\ matchEpoch = [o \in Orders |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch' = (epoch + 1) % Mod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pEpoch, matchedBy, matchEpoch, crashed>>

Refresh(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ pEpoch[p] # epoch
    /\ pEpoch' = [pEpoch EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
    /\ matchedBy' = [o \in Orders |-> IF matchedBy[o] = p THEN None ELSE matchedBy[o]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, matchEpoch, crashed>>

Match(p, o) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ pEpoch[p] = epoch
    /\ matchedBy[o] = None
    /\ matchedBy' = [matchedBy EXCEPT ![o] = p]
    /\ matchEpoch' = [matchEpoch EXCEPT ![o] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, crashed>>

Unmatch(o) ==
    /\ matchedBy[o] # None
    /\ matchedBy' = [matchedBy EXCEPT ![o] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, matchEpoch, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ matchedBy' = [o \in Orders |-> IF matchedBy[o] = p THEN None ELSE matchedBy[o]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, matchEpoch>>

Recover(p) ==
    /\ p \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pEpoch, matchedBy, matchEpoch>>

Next ==

    \/ \E p \in Participants : Refresh(p)
    \/ \E p \in Participants, o \in Orders : Match(p, o)
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Unmatch(o)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Recover(p)

(* Hospital operating-room scheduler committing a surgery booking via two-phase
   commit. A coordinator opens a voting round; participants vote yes. A
   participant can be superseded (marked stale) when reassigned, and a stale
   coordinator's in-flight round is torn down immediately. Participants may be
   slow to vote but never fail. Whenever a booking round is in flight or
   committed, its coordinator is not stale. *)

CONSTANTS Participants, None

VARIABLES phase, coord, votes, stale

vars == <<phase, coord, votes, stale>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "committed"}
    /\ coord \in Participants \cup {None}
    /\ votes \in [Participants -> 0..2]
    /\ stale \in SUBSET Participants

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ coord = None
    /\ votes = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ stale = {}

Begin(c) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ c \notin stale
    /\ coord' = c
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED stale

Vote(p, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ p \notin stale
    /\ votes[p] = 0
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, coord, stale>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ coord \notin stale
    /\ \A p \in Participants : votes[p] = 1
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coord, votes, stale>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ coord' = None
    /\ votes' = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED stale

Finish ==
    /\ phase = "committed"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ coord' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, stale>>

MarkStale(p) ==
    /\ p \notin stale
    /\ stale' = stale \cup {p}
    /\ IF coord = p /\ phase # "idle"
         THEN phase' = "idle" /\ coord' = None /\ votes' = [q \in Participants |-> 0]
         ELSE UNCHANGED <<phase, coord, votes>>

Refresh(p) ==
    /\ p \in stale
    /\ stale' = stale \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, coord, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Participants : Begin(c)
    \/ \E p \in Participants, v \in {1, 2} : Vote(p, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort

Because a stale coordinator's round is always torn down immediately, no booking round is ever in flight or committed under a stale coordinator. ---------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m2p0t0 ----------------------------
(* Warehouse robot fleet contending for a single charging bay via two-phase
   commit. A robot requests entry, participants vote, and entry commits only if
   every participant voted yes and the bay is currently empty. A robot can
   crash silently, which vacates the bay if it was charging and tears down its
   pending request. At most one robot occupies the bay at any time. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Robots, None

VARIABLES inCS, phase, candidate, votes, crashed

vars == <<inCS, phase, candidate, votes, crashed>>

Occupants == Cardinality({r \in Robots : inCS[r]})

TypeOK ==
    /\ inCS \in [Robots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}
    /\ candidate \in Robots \cup {None}
    /\ votes \in [Robots -> 0..2]
    /\ crashed \in SUBSET Robots

Init ==
    /\ inCS = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ candidate = None
    /\ votes = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

Request(r) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ ~inCS[r]
    /\ candidate' = r
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [p \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, crashed>>

Vote(p, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ votes[p] = 0
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, phase, candidate, crashed>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ candidate \notin crashed
    /\ \A p \in Robots : votes[p] = 1
    /\ Occupants = 0
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![candidate] = TRUE]
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ candidate' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, crashed>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ candidate' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, votes, crashed>>

Exit(r) ==
    /\ inCS[r]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, candidate, votes, crashed>>

Crash(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ IF candidate = r
         THEN phase' = "idle" /\ candidate' = None
         ELSE UNCHANGED <<phase, candidate>>
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

Recover(r) ==
    /\ r \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, phase, candidate, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Request(r)
    \/ \E p \in Robots, v \in {1, 2} : Vote(p, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Exit(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Crash(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Recover(r)

A robot that wants to charge issues an entry request, which opens a voting round; the other robots act as participants and vote yes or no. Entry is committed only when every participant has voted yes, the requesting robot has not crashed, and the charging bay is currently empty; on commit the robot enters the bay. If any participant votes no or the round is otherwise abandoned, it aborts. A robot in the bay eventually exits, freeing it. Any robot can crash silently at any moment: a crash vacates the bay if that robot was charging, and if the crashed robot was the one whose entry was being voted on, its pending round is torn down. A crashed robot can later recover and rejoin the fleet. Because entry commits only while the bay is empty, the bay never holds two robots at once. ---------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m5p1t3 ----------------------------
(* Interbank settlement ledger updated by quorum-approved writes. A bank stages
   a write against a snapshot of the ledger and gathers a quorum of approvals;
   the write commits only if the ledger still equals its snapshot, so a bank
   whose snapshot went stale (a rival committed first) must retry instead of
   overwriting. Banks may be slow to vote but never fail. The ledger value
   always equals the number of applied writes. *)
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Voters
Quorum == 2
MaxV == 2

VARIABLES ledger, applied, snap, staged, votes

vars == <<ledger, applied, snap, staged, votes>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ ledger \in 0..MaxV
    /\ applied \in 0..MaxV
    /\ snap \in [Banks -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ staged \in [Banks -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ votes \in [Banks -> SUBSET Voters]

Init ==
    /\ ledger = 0
    /\ applied = 0
    /\ snap = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ staged = [b \in Banks |-> FALSE]
    /\ votes = [b \in Banks |-> {}]

Stage(b) ==
    /\ ~staged[b]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![b] = ledger]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied>>

Vote(b, w) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ w \notin votes[b]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = @ \cup {w}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied, snap, staged>>

Commit(b) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ Cardinality(votes[b]) >= Quorum
    /\ snap[b] = ledger
    /\ ledger < MaxV
    /\ ledger' = snap[b] + 1
    /\ applied' = applied + 1
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, votes>>

Retry(b) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ snap[b] # ledger
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied, snap, votes>>

Abort(b) ==
    /\ staged[b]
    /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, applied, snap, votes>>

Compact ==
    /\ ledger = MaxV
    /\ \A b \in Banks : ~staged[b]
    /\ ledger' = 0
    /\ applied' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, staged, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Stage(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, w \in Voters : Vote(b, w)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Commit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Retry(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Abort(b)
    \/ Compact

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

============================================================================
nl: A bank's interbank settlement batch maintains a shared settlement ledger that several banks update concurrently, with each update gated by quorum voting. A bank that wants to post an update first stages it, recording a snapshot of the ledger's current value and opening a fresh approval tally. Voters then approve the staged update, and the update may commit only once a quorum of voters has approved it. On commit, the ledger is set to the staging bank's snapshot plus one, but only if the ledger still equals that snapshot; if a rival bank committed in the meantime, the snapshot is stale and the commit is refused, forcing the staging bank to retry from a fresh snapshot rather than overwrite the rival's update. Banks can be slow to gather approvals but they never fail. A bank may also abort its staged update, and when the ledger reaches its ceiling with nothing staged the batch compacts back to zero along with the applied-write count. Because a stale commit is always rejected, no committed update is silently overwritten. The full action set is: stage an update, cast an approval vote, commit on quorum, retry after a stale snapshot, abort a staged update, and compact at the ceiling. SAFETY PROPERTY: the ledger value always equals the number of updates that have been applied to it.
